name: Dumbbell Clean
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hinge with bent knees to grip two dumbbells beside your feet.
Drive explosively through your feet, extending your hips and knees while shrugging to pull the dumbbells up close.
Drop slightly into a quarter squat as you flip your elbows forward to catch the dumbbells on your shoulders.
Stand tall to finish the catch, then lower the dumbbells under control back to your sides or the floor.
tips: Let your hips drive the dumbbells upward before your arms guide the catch.
Keep your spine flat on the pull and brace your core as you receive the weight.
